purpose: distinguish contemporary colonization, rescue/persistence, historical colonization legacy, and environmental-proxy explanations for prospectively observed source-decoupling without using mechanism analyses to rescue the Structural primary

shared_predictor_state.extreme_isolation_primary: upper 25% of one predictor-only isolation distribution frozen before response access
shared_predictor_state.source_decoupling_secondary: source-conditioned connectivity exceeds the generic connectivity representation already included in the strong reference
shared_predictor_state.multi_hop_secondary: connected to a permitted source at the smallest frozen graph scale while direct source distance exceeds that scale

M1_contemporary_colonization.minimum_data: at least two occupancy states with a prospectively frozen transition design; repeated detection data required when nondetection is plausibly substantial
M1_contemporary_colonization.estimand: incremental colonization support of source-decoupling or multi-hop state beyond the strong ecological reference
M1_contemporary_colonization.favourable_direction: higher colonization probability or lower held-out transition loss in source-connected state
required_controls: observation/detection process when repeated survey data permit
M1_contemporary_colonization.discriminating_prediction: source-decoupling predicts 0_to_1 transitions after controls; an effect confined to 1_to_1 persistence does not establish this lane

M2_rescue_persistence.minimum_data: at least two occupancy states with a prospectively frozen transition design; repeated detection data required when nondetection is plausibly substantial
M2_rescue_persistence.estimand: incremental extinction-risk reduction or persistence support of source-decoupling beyond the strong ecological reference
M2_rescue_persistence.favourable_direction: lower local extinction probability or higher persistence probability in source-connected state
required_controls: observation/detection process when repeated survey data permit
M2_rescue_persistence.discriminating_prediction: source-decoupling predicts reduced 1_to_0 loss or increased 1_to_1 persistence; a signal confined to 0_to_1 transitions does not establish rescue/persistence

M3_historical_colonization_legacy.minimum_data: population-genetic or phylogeographic information from focal populations and plausible source populations, sampled independently of favourable Structural outcomes
M3_historical_colonization_legacy.target: genetic affinity/source assignment conditional on geographic distance and available habitat/environment covariates
M3_historical_colonization_legacy.estimand: whether remote source-decoupled populations are genetically closer to the connected occupied-source set than equally or more geographically plausible alternatives
M3_historical_colonization_legacy.favourable_direction: greater genetic affinity to graph-connected source set beyond geographic distance/environment
required_controls: phylogenetic or population-structure nuisance terms when appropriate
M3_historical_colonization_legacy.discriminating_prediction: genetic affinity follows the frozen source-path relation even if contemporary 0_to_1 and 1_to_0 transition effects are weak; this is consistent with historical legacy but does not date the colonization event by itself
allowed_data_examples: F_ST or related genetic distance with appropriate controls
organellar plus nuclear phylogeography when resolution is adequate

M4_environmental_proxy.minimum_data: response-blind enriched habitat/environment predictors collected or defined before confirmatory outcome access
M4_environmental_proxy.target: incremental topology information after an enriched non-topological environmental reference
M4_environmental_proxy.estimand: whether source-decoupling/topology retains held-out information after plausible omitted habitat/environment structure is represented
M4_environmental_proxy.favourable_direction_for_proxy_explanati: topology increment collapses toward zero while enriched environmental reference improves held-out prediction
required_controls: same held-out partition used for topology comparison
M4_environmental_proxy.negative_control: environmental enrichment must be chosen without inspecting topology outcome direction and may not be expanded iteratively to erase a favourable topology result
M4_environmental_proxy.discriminating_prediction: if topology signal disappears under a prospectively enriched environmental reference and neither dynamic nor genetic lanes support connectivity, environmental proxy remains the leading explanation

interpretation_matrix.colonization_consistent: M1 supported; M2 may be supported or unsupported; M3/M4 do not override the contemporary 0_to_1 evidence
interpretation_matrix.rescue_persistence_consistent: M2 supported; M1 may be supported or unsupported; static occupancy alone is insufficient
interpretation_matrix.ongoing_connectivity_consistent: both M1 and M2 supported under the predeclared dynamic design
interpretation_matrix.historical_legacy_consistent: M3 supported while contemporary transition lanes are estimable but weak/unsupported; does not prove a unique historical route
interpretation_matrix.environmental_proxy_consistent: M4 proxy prediction supported while M1/M2/M3 provide no independent connectivity evidence
interpretation_matrix.mixed_or_unresolved: multiple lanes supported, lane non-estimability, or conflicting spatial-transfer results; no forced single-winner label

anti_selection: do not choose a system because A-Islands source-decoupling looked favourable
do not inspect 0_to_1 or 1_to_0 outcomes before freezing transition thresholds and partitions
do not merge colonization and extinction transitions after seeing which one is favourable
do not collect genetics only from populations selected by favourable topology residuals
do not add environmental predictors iteratively until topology disappears
do not call non-estimable dynamic lanes negative evidence
do not use any mechanism lane to rescue a failed Structural extreme-isolation primary
do not require one exclusive mechanism when evidence supports a mixture
